''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

'''The Wheel of Time''' translates (literally) as Колелото на времето<ref>[http://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%BE_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%B2%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BE Wheel of Time Wikipedia page (BG)]</ref> in Bulgarian. The books were published in Bulgarian by Bard Publishing House. Валерий Русинов (Valery Rusinov) translated all the volumes.<ref>[https://chitanka.info/serie/koleloto-na-vremeto The Wheel of Time - series at chitanka.com (BG)]</ref>

==Book Titles==
The following list contains English titles with the approximate ISO-9 transliteration of the Bulgarian title, the Bulgarian title itself and finally, the year of publication in Bulgarian (in parentheses).

Prequel  '''A New Spring''' - ''Nova prolet'' - Нова пролет  (2004)
#'''The Eye of the World''' - ''Okoto na sveta'' - Окото на света  (1998)
#'''The Great Hunt'''  - ''Velikiyat lov'' - Великият лов  (1998)
#'''The Dragon Reborn''' - ''Prerodeniyat drakon'' - Прероденият дракон  (1999)
#'''The Strength of the Shadow''' - ''Silata na syankata'' - Силата на сянката  (1999)
#'''The Fires of Heaven''' - ''Nebesniyat ogǎn'' - Небесният огън  (1999)
#'''The Lord of Chaos''' - ''Gospodaryat na haosa'' - Господарят на хаоса  (1999)
#'''A Crown of Swords''' - ''Korona ot mečove'' - Корона от мечове  (1999)
#'''The Path of the Dagger''' - ''Pǎtyat na kinžala'' - Пътят на кинжала  (2000)
#'''The Heart of the Winter''' - ''Sǎrtseto na zimata'' - Сърцето на зимата  (2001)
#'''Crossroads at Twilight''' - ''Krǎstopǎtishta po zdrač'' - Кръстопътища по здрач  (2003)
#'''A Knife of Dreams''' - ''Nož ot blyanove'' - Нож от блянове  (2006)
#'''A Storm is Rising''' - ''Burya se nadiga'' - Буря се надига  (2010)
#'''Midnight Towers''' - ''Srednoštni kuli'' - Среднощни кули  (2011)
#'''A Memory of Light''' - ''Spomen za svetlina'' - Спомен за светлина  (2013)
